_comment: FY2025 grounded actuals (telco; uses the tech schema — revenue/net profit/margins/FCF/EPS — plus EBITDA which telcos lead on). Source: Ooredoo Group FY2025 earnings release, Feb 2026 (ooredoo.com), confirmed by Economy Middle East / Qatar Tribune / Investing.com. Revenue QAR 24.6bn (+4% reported, +6% ex-Myanmar); reported net profit QAR 3.9bn (+12%, record); EBITDA QAR 10.5bn (+5%, margin 42.6%); capex QAR 4.6bn; free cash flow QAR 5.9bn (-13%); customer base 147.1m incl. IOH. Proposed cash dividend QAR 0.75/sh (+15%, historic high; 50-70% payout policy). EPS omitted — group net profit includes large minority interests (IOH), so a shares-based EPS would overstate the attributable figure.

fy_highlights.source: Ooredoo Group FY2025 earnings release, Feb 2026 (ooredoo.com); Economy Middle East
